Utah Retirement Systems Has Lifted Its Position in Lennar (LEN) by $613,350 as Share Price Declined; Horrell Capital Management Position in Allot Communications (ALLT) Has Cut by $643,835 as Valuation Declined
June 2, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Utah Retirement Systems increased its stake in Lennar Corp (LEN) by 28.55% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Utah Retirement Systems bought 10,575 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.19% with the market. The institutional investor held 47,618 shares of the homebuilding company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.81 million, up from 37,043 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Utah Retirement Systems who had been investing in Lennar Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.63 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.23% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $51.62. About 3.82 million shares traded. Lennar Corporation (NYSE:LEN) has risen 5.00% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.57% the S&P500.
Horrell Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Allot Communications (ALLT) by 57.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Horrell Capital Management Inc sold 128,767 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.73% with the market. The institutional investor held 94,300 shares of the computer communications equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $507,000, down from 223,067 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Horrell Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Allot Communications for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $181.04 million market cap company.
